warnings.message: The FEB 26 filename label and Jan-26 sheet title do not establish precise effective dates.
Fuel is not stated on the policy schedule and no approved external vehicle-master source was supplied.
Previous insurer is not identified in the inspected policy pages and is not inferred.
SMALL is retained in the make/model mapping but is not a visible private-car matrix column.
H4, H5, and H6 remain conditional/unresolved and are not applied.
The separate PC STP Non-Diesel area contains explicit zero values; they are preserved raw and not interpreted as a commission rule or decline.
Enabler, hygiene, and synergy rows are retained with citations but their private-car applicability is not inferred or applied.
Phase 2A dimension metadata differs from source inspection expectations: Enabler, PO Guidelines & T&C. Observed values are retained without rewriting the IR.
